description: Before the run (status ready): change the role of criteria (required = must be proven, plus = a bonus) and how strictly they are proven (inference = may be inferred, explicit = needs an explicit source; dearer), and the order of the sources. No AI call; the estimate is counted again. Needs a plan (or credits). [REST: PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/spec]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

version.description: The spec version from get_search (optional: protects against an edit made meanwhile in the web).
